Illegal func-
tioning by Pub-
lic Safety Bureau
in Continental
Terrace Scott Road.

At 10.55 p.m. 18-10-33, J.P.C.s 179 & 229
reported at the Station that at about 10.30 p.m.
18-10-33 they had witnessed a Party of Chapei
Police enter Lane 26 House No.5 (S.M.C.No.) Scott
Road.

Inspector Shellswell, officer in charge,
accompanied by Clerk Chang and J.P.C. 229 immediate-
ly proceeded to the above premises where inquiries
were made and the following information obtained.

At about 10.30 p.m. 18-10-33 Kong Kying Myan
and Tsang Siao Kur detectives attached to the
Special Branch, Bureau.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号 D
日期 / /

斯科特路大陆公寓
公共安全局
非法行动。

1933年10月18日晚上10点55分，华籍巡捕第179号和第229号向警局报告称，在1933年10月18日晚上10点30分左右，他们目睹一群闸北警察进入斯科特路（工部局编号）26弄5号。

负责警官谢尔斯韦尔督察（Inspector Shellswell）在文员张姓华员及华籍巡捕第229号的陪同下，立即前往上述处所进行调查，并获得如下信息。

1933年10月18日晚上10点30分左右，孔景明（Kong Kying Myan，音译）和曾小菊（Tsang Siao Kur，音译），系隶属于南市公共安全局特别股的侦探，

pages.en:
of Public Safety, Nantao, assisted by Sub-Inspector Wong
Yui Hsung and six Chapei constables in uniform from the 3rd
Station, Chapei, had raided premises Lane 26 House 5(S.M.C.No.)
Continental Terrace Scott Road(which is on the West side of
Scott Road) to effect the arrest of certain persons, alleged
to belong to the Communist Party.
The Detectives on being questioned stated that they
had no evidence to warrant the arrest of the following persons,
namely:- Zung Yok Sin, native of Kwantung, Zia Sing Ming,native
of Canton, Hsu Chien, native of 'ainan and Tso Yi Hsieh,native
of Kwantung or anything to prove that they are members of a
communistic organisation. They stated they were acting on the
instructions received from Nanking. The Chapei Police also
arrested a Netherland subject named Mas Shoehandy, student who
also resides on the premises. This man was in possession of
a passport issued by the Netherland Authorities in Java, No.
18771 and also bears an endorsement of registration by the
local Consulate dated 22/8/32. The Chapei Police on being
shown the passport signified their desire not to detain him.
Capt. Kennedy,D.O.'O' was informed and gave instruc-
tions for the man to be brought to the Station, pending the
Chinese Authorities getting a warrant. They were informed of
the instructions received and agreed to allow the men to be
taken charge of by Bixwell Road Station, pending further
instructions from their Headquarters. These men deny being
members of any communist Party.
The Special Branch was informed and D.S. Tilton and
Inspector Mah attended and took down statements from the
suspected persons.
Inquiries failed to disclose any information to
substantiate the allegations that these men were members of
the Communist Party. These men on the instruction of Supt.
Kennedy, D.O.'O' are being detained pending further instructions.
Bixwell Road Station, 24/8/32
pages.zh:
在黄耀雄（Wong Yui Hsung，音译）副督察及六名来自闸北第三分局的着装闸北巡捕的协助下，突袭了位于斯科特路（西侧）的大陆公寓斯科特路26弄5号（工部局编号），旨在逮捕据称属于共产党的人员。
经讯问，这些侦探表示，他们没有证据 warrant 逮捕以下人员，即：广东籍的钟若仙（Zung Yok Sin，音译）、广州籍的夏星明（Xia Sing Ming，音译）、海南籍的徐健（Hsu Chien，音译）以及广东籍的左一谢（Tso Yi Hsieh，音译），也没有任何证据证明他们是共产主义组织的成员。他们声称是奉南京方面的指示行事。闸北警察还逮捕了一名居住在该处的荷兰籍学生，名为 Mas Shoehandy（音译）。此人持有由荷属爪哇当局签发的护照，号码为18771，并带有当地领事馆于1932年8月22日签署的注册背书。闸北警察在查验护照后，表示不希望拘留此人。
“O”区警司肯尼迪上尉（Capt. Kennedy, D.O.'O'）获悉此事后，指示将该人带至警局，以待中国当局取得逮捕令。中方人员获知所收到的指示后，同意让这些人员由毕克威尔路警局（Bixwell Road Station）看管，以待其总部进一步指示。这些人否认是任何共产党的成员。
特别股已获通知，副探长蒂尔顿（D.S. Tilton）和马赫督察（Inspector Mah）到场，并记录了嫌疑人的供词。
调查未能发现任何信息来证实这些人属于共产党的指控。根据“O”区警司肯尼迪上尉的指示，这些人正被拘留，以待进一步指示。
毕克威尔路警局，1932年8月24日
